record.issue_text: Dedupe vs existing attendees uses exact match, so case/whitespace variants create duplicate attendees for the same person

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, deduping uses exact string comparison against existing attendee emails: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` and blacklist check `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` without normalizing case (or trimming). Since `addGuests.schema.ts` only validates `z.string().email()` (no normalization) and `AddGuestsDialog` passes user-entered strings directly, case variants like `Test@Example.com` vs `test@example.com` can bypass the check and be inserted via `createMany`, creating duplicates for the same person.
